parameters.help_en:
Ensures the idempotency of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.name: document_type

parameters.help_en: The document number of the registrant. The number cannot exceed 50 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 注册者证件号码。长度不超过50字符
parameters.name: document_code

parameters.help_en: The email address. The address cannot exceed 300 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 电子邮箱。长度不超过300字符
parameters.name: email

parameters.help_en: The document image of the registrant (base64-encoded). The original file size must be between 50 KB and 3 MB
parameters.help_zh: 注册者证件图片(base64)。原文件大小为50KB-3MB
parameters.name: document_image

parameters.help_en: The country or region of the registrant. Specify a 2-character country or region code (refer to GB/T 2659.1-2022)
parameters.help_zh: 注册者所属国家或地区，2位的国家地区代码（参考GB/T 2659.1-2022）
parameters.name: cc

parameters.help_en: The province of the registrant. The value cannot exceed 255 characters in length. If the country is China, the value must comply with GB/T 2260-2007
parameters.help_zh: 注册者所在省。长度不超过255字符。所属国家是中国的，需符合GB/T 2260-2007要求
parameters.name: state

parameters.help_en: The city of the registrant. The value cannot exceed 255 characters in length. If the country is China, the value must comply with GB/T 2260-2007
parameters.help_zh: 注册者所在市。长度不超过255字符。所属国家是中国的，需符合GB/T 2260-2007要求
parameters.name: city

parameters.help_en: The address of the registrant. The value cannot exceed 255 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 注册者地址。长度不超过255字符
parameters.name: street

parameters.help_en: The phone number of the registrant. The value cannot exceed 128 characters in length. If the country is China and the number is not a mobile phone number, the area code must match the city
parameters.help_zh: 注册者联系电话。长度不超过128字符。所属国家是中国的，非手机号码区号需与所在市匹配
parameters.name: phone
